$comment: RAY-CLOUD shared contract 1.0.0-rc.2. Reserved operator binding names and the rule for application-grantable names.

reservedExact.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
reservedExact.purpose: redirects provider traffic; egress is operator-controlled

reservedExact.name: DEEPGRAM_BASE_URL
reservedExact.purpose: redirects provider traffic; egress is operator-controlled

reservedExact.name: NO_PROXY
reservedExact.purpose: egress proxy bypass; host network policy

reservedExact.name: ALL_PROXY
reservedExact.purpose: egress proxy for every scheme; host network policy

reservedExact.name: BASH_ENV
reservedExact.purpose: file a non-interactive shell sources before it runs

reservedExact.name: GLIBC_TUNABLES
reservedExact.purpose: C library behaviour of every child process

reservedExact.name: OPENSSL_CONF
reservedExact.purpose: OpenSSL configuration file, which can load engines and providers

reservedExact.purpose: trusted certificate bundle; replacing it allows interception of provider traffic

reservedExact.name: SSL_CERT_DIR
reservedExact.purpose: trusted certificate directory; replacing it allows interception of provider traffic

reservedExact.name: CLOUD_PROVIDER_TOKEN
reservedExact.purpose: example of a cloud credential that a bundle can never obtain

reservedExact.purpose: file variant of OPENAI_API_KEY; names a host path, so only the operator environment supplies it

reservedExact.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_FILE
reservedExact.purpose: file variant of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; names a host path, so only the operator environment supplies it

reservedExact.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE
reservedExact.purpose: file variant of CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; names a host path, so only the operator environment supplies it

reservedExact.name: CODEX_API_KEY_FILE
reservedExact.purpose: file variant of CODEX_API_KEY; names a host path, so only the operator environment supplies it

reservedExact.name: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY_FILE
reservedExact.purpose: file variant of DEEPGRAM_API_KEY; names a host path, so only the operator environment supplies it

reservedPrefixes.covers: every platform setting and boot secret, including RAYSPEC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY, RAYSPEC_API_KEY_PEPPER, RAYSPEC_MEDIA_SIGNING_KEY, RAYSPEC_BLOB_ROOT, RAYSPEC_HANDLER_ROOT, RAYSPEC_AGENT_TRACING, RAYSPEC_TRUSTED_PROXIES, RAYSPEC_SKIP_DOTENV and their _FILE variants
libpq connection settings (PGHOST, PGPASSWORD and others)
agent SDK tracing and export switches

Anthropic SDK settings, which the agent CLI subprocess inherits (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL redirects provider traffic and the key with it; ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN replaces the credential); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stays platform-grantable
agent CLI settings (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and CLAUDE_CODE_ switches that select another provider endpoint); CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN stays platform-grantable

rules: A name is reserved when it equals a reservedExact name, or starts with a reservedPrefixes prefix and is not a platformGrantable name, compared byte for byte after the namePattern check. Reserved names come only from the operator.

A bundle that declares a reserved name in bindings is refused by verify, deploy and prepare with RAY_BINDING_RESERVED. A bindings file that supplies a reserved name is refused the same way; the operator supplies reserved names through the explicit process environment or the host, never through the application bindings file.

platformGrantable names are the only names the platform itself reads from application bindings. A bundle may declare them; the value is supplied by the customer or operator at deploy time, in the bindings file or the explicit process environment.

The _FILE variant of each platformGrantable name (its fileVariant) is reserved and listed in reservedExact. It names a host path, so only the operator supplies it, through the explicit process environment; the platform then reads the named file, which must pass the same permission checks as the bindings file. A bundle or bindings file that supplies a _FILE variant is refused with RAY_BINDING_RESERVED, and the platform never reads a path taken from application bindings.
Any other name that matches namePattern and is not reserved is application-defined: the platform never reads it and passes it only to the application process environment.
Declaring a name never grants a value. A request for a reserved name such as CLOUD_PROVIDER_TOKEN is refused, not silently dropped.
On the .ray deploy path no .env file is loaded, whatever RAYSPEC_SKIP_DOTENV says: bindings come only from --bindings-file and the explicit process environment.
Binding values never appear in any output, log, plan, receipt or error message; only names do.

bindingsFile.description: The --bindings-file format. A regular file owned by the invoking user with mode 0600 or stricter, not a link. Canonical JSON is not required on input. Names must be unique; a duplicate name is refused with RAY_USAGE.
